name: scheduling

terminology.meaning: A workload unit in a simulation, not a human participant.
The scheduling delay reported under the paper's stated workload.

screening_hints: Retain papers that report a scheduling workload, metric, or comparator.

fields.label: Simulated jobs
fields.description: Number of simulated jobs in the reported workload.

fields.label: Waiting time
fields.description: Reported waiting-time result with its condition.

evaluation_criteria.text: Preserve workload and arrival conditions when comparing values.
Do not transfer an unreported baseline between works.
Do not describe simulated jobs as human participants or observed deployment.

writing_structure.title: Workload context
writing_structure.purpose: Describe each simulated workload and missing conditions.

writing_structure.title: Conditional comparison
writing_structure.purpose: Compare waiting-time findings without erasing different conditions.

writing_structure.title: Transfer limits
writing_structure.purpose: State what the simulations cannot establish about real systems.
